outputs.explanation: Panel A contains a bar chart of mean ± s.d. cell death (%) from three independent experiments, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B contains a bar chart of cell death (%), but no individual data points are shown; error bars appear present but underlying replicate values are not overlaid.
Panel C is a bar chart with mean ± s.d. of three experiments across time points and genotypes, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel D contains a bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars, but no individual data points are shown overlaid on the bars.
